name: MTU/MSS/record预算
summary: 统一计算外层IPv4、MSS、record及Game/FEC开销，派生内层TUN MTU与安全失败。

defaults.--outer-mtu: 1460（默认完整外层IPv4 IP MTU；不含L2；最大显式1500）
defaults.allowed: 576..1500（IPv4 公开配置；jumbo 需独立实验验证）
defaults.tun-mtu: 由 Rust V4 冷预算自动计算并经 owned OS 接口真实读回；只读
defaults.windows_record_offer: Rust original TLS cold receive budget v1; previously hard-coded 1400 cap removed in new production cold path; this does not alter authenticated peer MSS or OS applied checks
defaults.outer-ip-mtu: 1460B default, complete outer IPv4 IP packet (no L2); operator may still explicitly configure up to 1500B
defaults.default-1460-inner-golden: Normal1389, FEC/Auto1375, Game1373, GameFEC1358 on 20+20 IPv4/TCP and no smaller per-direction path
defaults.local_syn_mss: Rust冷预算：min(configured_outer_ip_mtu, live_physical_outer_ip_mtu)-IPv4(20)-TCP(20); 1400→1360 / 默认1460→1420 / 显式1500→1460；不扣record31，不用旧FakeTCP 1360回退

usage.cli: Linux V4 --outer-mtu default1460, source-locked original-Go Linux client/server and Windows client --mtu default1460; all values are full outer IPv4 IP ceilings; inner always derived/read-only
usage.config: 只保存外层MTU configured intent(默认1460/显式最大1500)，内层和SYN MSS均由同一Rust cold预算自动派生；无legacy/modern MSS开关
usage.gui: GUI外层MTU默认1460/最大显式1500；本地MSS、peer MSS、record和真实Wintun MTU仅只读，完整GUI数值展示原生仍待验收
